mainEntity.name: What kind of gas line do I need for an outdoor built-in grill?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an outdoor built-in grill, you typically need a dedicated natural gas line or a propane tank connection. Natural gas lines are more convenient as they eliminate the need for tank refills but require professional installation from your home's main gas supply. Propane offers flexibility in placement but requires managing tank levels. The decision factor often revolves around convenience versus initial installation cost and placement flexibility.
